title: Your Jarvis HUD
lede: Your HUD is your CRM and your command centre: what needs you, pipeline, leads, campaigns, clients, results and Talk to Jarvis. About 20 minutes.
deliverable: They leave with their HUD live, connected to Jarvis, and their missions on the dashboard.
body:
Jarvis walks you through every step and checks each one before the next.

Start it in Jarvis

Use the jarvis-hq skill to set up my Agency HQ.

You: Use the jarvis-hq skill to set up my Agency HQ.

Jarvis: Let’s do it. First, in Base44 click Create new app and name it Agency HQ. Don’t type anything into it yet. Tell me when it’s there.

This message goes into the new app’s builder chat, not into Jarvis.

Install the app

  1. Open your new Agency HQ app in Base44.
  2. In its builder chat, attach agency-hq-v3.16.1.zip from this lesson.
  3. Paste the message below in the same message and send it.

Install the attached Agency HQ v3.16.1 package into this app as the exact source of truth. Unzip it and copy every file under source/ into this project at the same paths, replacing what is there. Copy in this order: everything under base44/ first, then src/api/, src/lib/, src/hooks/, src/utils/, then src/components/, then src/pages/, then src/index.css, and last src/App.jsx, src/main.jsx and index.html. Restart or reload the dev server after copying. Make sure every entity in base44/entities/ exists exactly as defined (19 tables). Deploy every backend function in base44/functions/ exactly as written (20 functions), including connections, sendCheck, retellWebhook, which Retell calls from outside without a login because it checks Retell's signature itself, and jarvisVoice. Register the workflow in base44/workflows/ and confirm it is active. Make sure package.json lists three 0.171.0 and retell-client-js-sdk 3.0.3 exactly, and install them. Never rename or move a file and never change an import path to work around an error. Keep the app's login requirement on. Do not redesign, simplify or recreate any page, component, style, entity, function, shared module or workflow. Run the build and fix only genuine build errors. Report: every table, every deployed function (send each an empty POST and give the status code; none may be 404), the workflow status, and the build result. Do not publish.

Before continuing: send Jarvis a screenshot of the builder’s report. If anything is missing, Jarvis gives you the exact message to send the builder.

Your HUD only connects once it is published. Publishing twice makes sure everything has loaded.

Publish twice

  1. Click Publish. When it’s done, click Publish again.
  2. Open your published HUD, then Settings.

Settings, Connections. Every line has a ? that tells you what it is and where to get it.

Connect everything in one place

ConnectionWhat to do
Jarvis accessMake an access token in Jarvis (Settings, Developer, Create access token, One app or Superagent, the Agent entry, Full access), paste it, press Save.
HUD keyAlready created for you. Press Get it for Jarvis, then Copy, paste it into your Jarvis chat and send it. Then press Test Jarvis connection under Jarvis access: it should say Jarvis is connected.
Live voice (optional add-on)Paste your Retell key, press Test key, then Set up my voice. The app builds your Jarvis voice for you.

Keys are saved securely and never shown again. Only their last 4 characters appear, so you can see which one is saved.

  1. Still in Settings, add your Jarvis agent ID and your name. For voice, choose Base44, or Retell if you set up the add-on.
  2. In Jarvis’s settings, General, give Jarvis access to the Agency HQ app.
  3. Tell Jarvis “Done”. It checks every part.

Before continuing: every line in Connections you need says Connected, your HUD shows your missions, and Talk to Jarvis answers “What’s next?”

If it looks different: send Jarvis a screenshot. It knows each step and will fix it with you.
